text:
Maya: Quick launch-week check — need final go/no-go on search bids and retarget creative swap. We go live at 10:00 PT.
Sam: onboarding page traffic looks solid. Recommend keeping search spend flat first 6 hours then scale if CPA < $45.
Leo: Pixel health: retarget list size is 78k, but lookback window includes old T7 rules. Suggest T14 for webinar promo.
Adrian: For webinar ads, use 2 creatives: long-form demo + short social clip. Swap at hour 12 if CTR < 0.6% :eyes:
Maya: Can someone confirm UTM params? I don't want messy analytics later.
Sam: Using this UTM template:
```
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=launch_week&utm_content={creative_id}
```
Maya: perfect — attach to search and retarget links.
CampaignBot: Created campaign `launch_week_search_A` (id: 4621) and adset `rw-webinar-retarget` (id: 771). :robot_face:
Leo: Quick check — are we excluding converters last 30d from retarget? Otherwise we'll overserve.
Sam: Yes excluded. Also set CPA bid cap to $50 and daily cap to $1,200 for first 24h. We'll monitor hourly.
Adrian: Creative refresh plan: rotate creative B at +12h, creative C at +24h if engagement dips. Keep A/B results in the doc.
Maya: Who owns hourly pacing? I can look but need one owner for alerts.
Sam: I'll own pacing and alarms. Will wire alerts to #marketing and send 10% drop alerts.
Maya: Cool. If CPA drifts >20% after scaling we pull back and revert to baseline creatives.
Leo: Also watch landing page load times — if >2.5s, conversion collapses. @infra FYI.
Maya: thanks team. Check-in at +6h for first pulse. :rocket:
